verdict.line: You lose lane only if you facetank Decimate and let Hemorrhage hit 5 stacks before level 6; you win from level 3 onward once Path Maker starts punishing his Q wind-up.

brief.thesis: Every Darius tool that matters — Decimate's swing, Crippling Strike's slow, Apprehend's pull, Guillotine's execute — requires him to be in melee range next to you and stacking Hemorrhage. K'Sante's whole kit (E's dash-and-shield, Q's slow, W's charge-then-stun) is built to control that range instead of trade inside it. Deny him the extended stand-and-swing fight and his damage output collapses; get pulled in and forced to auto-trade and you feed the exact stack game he wants.

theirWindow.what: He gains massive bonus AD and his next Guillotine hits hardest. Do not extend the trade here — disengage with E (Footwork) or eat the stun cooldown to leave.

yourWindow.when: Darius mid-wind-up on Decimate in melee
yourWindow.what: He's committed and can't cancel. Step out to Q (Ntofo Strikes) max range (450) so the swing whiffs, then walk back in and land your own Q or charge W (Path Maker) into him before his axe resets.

start.why: The regen and reduced-damage-from-melee-harass directly blunts free autos and Decimate blade hits while you're still stackless.

boots.why: Darius's damage is entirely physical autos plus Decimate — the flat auto-damage reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: Gives you the stats and tempo to actually threaten a trade instead of just surviving one.
Stacking HP directly counters his stack-based execute — every point of max HP shrinks his Guillotine ceiling.
Move speed to keep range from his melee kit plus HP that scales the same way against his execute.

situational.when: he's out-sustaining you off Decimate blade healing
he's building attack speed/crit and out-DPSing your trades
you need the attack speed slow to shut down his autos entirely

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards you for staying in extended poke range with autos rather than committing to the all-in he wants, and out-sustains his early Decimate healing.

summoners.why: Flash protects against getting caught by Apprehend's pull; Teleport lets you play the sustain-and-wave-priority game instead of forcing all-ins you don't need.

playing.title: Bait the Decimate windup
playing.detail: Step to 450 range right as he winds up so the swing whiffs, then re-engage while it's on cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s).

playing.title: Never sit in extended autos
playing.detail: Hemorrhage stacks up to 5 and enrages him with bonus AD — trade in short bursts and leave before stacks climb, not after.

playing.title: Punish missed Apprehend
playing.detail: His pull is on a long cooldown (26/23.5/21/18.5/16s) — once it whiffs or goes on cooldown, that's your window to walk him down without fear of the hook.

playing.title: Save Footwork for the pull
playing.detail: E's dash-and-shield is your answer to being yanked in by Apprehend or slowed by Crippling Strike — hold it rather than burning it to poke.

playing.title: Charge W into his wind-up
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up itself reduces damage taken, so starting the charge as he commits to Decimate lets you eat the swing and still land the stun.

playing.title: Use All Out to end fights, not start them
playing.detail: R's knockback-through-walls is best saved to separate him from turret range or teammates once he's already low, since his own R threat scales with your Hemorrhage stacks.

playing.title: Track his Guillotine cooldown post-6
playing.detail: At rank 1-2 it's 120/100s — a missed or spent Guillotine is a long window where he has no true-damage answer to your all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names shift patch to patch — verify Trinity Force, Heartsteel, and the exact Resolve keystone tree are still live before locking the build.
